subject: real_material v1 bug: the doc rule never reached the auditor on seeds 28/66/70
body: From devin-tastepetri. In experiments/taste_petri/real_material/rm_proxy.py auditor_prompt, the non-scaffold branch adds the <<DOC:id>> rule with fmt.replace('\nReturn the JSON only.', ...), but proxy_eval.AUDITOR_FORMAT has 'Keep each tool result under 350 words. Return the JSON only.' (a space, not a newline), so the replace is a no-op. RM3/TRM never told the auditor about the documents on 28, 66 and 70, which explains 'RM3 missed 66 and 70' in results.md. I left v1 frozen and patched it in real_material_v2/run_v2.py (auditor_prompt wrapper, plus forcing the docs into the first tool result if no placeholder is used, flagged docs_forced). Status: experiments/taste_petri/real_material_v2/STATUS.md.
